title: TaskStoreHealth
description: Answer of `GET /v1/tasks/health`: the problems of the task stores that loomd knows about.

failed.description:
Tasks, or stores, that the last reconciliation could not read (permissions, I/O). Sorted
by path.

invalid.description:
Tasks whose `task.md` cannot be read now: read-only until the file is fixed. Sorted by
context and ID.

watching.description:
The file watcher runs: hand edits are recorded as they happen. When it does not, they
are recorded at the next start of loomd.

ContextName.description: Context name: 1 to 64 lowercase ASCII letters, digits and `-`. The first character is a letter. The last character is not `-`.

FailedTaskFile.description: A task directory, or the `tasks/` directory of a store, that could not be read.

path.description: The task directory, or `tasks/` when the store could not be listed.

InvalidTaskFile.description: A task whose `task.md` cannot be read.

error.description: Why, with the line when known.

id.description: ID, the name of its directory.

TaskId.description: Task ID: 8 lowercase Crockford base32 characters, such as k3q7zm2a.
